notes: Parent-only pass across 32 platform/type search lanes and 447 distinct search results. Thirty-five source-reviewed additions, one proven historical-copy duplicate and two placeholders deferred. URL/decision screening eliminated prior work, then title/ancestry review caught an unmarked fork. Search acronyms CPC, SC-3000, NES and Lynx produce substantial unrelated results and platform ambiguity; Camputers Lynx was classified from source, not query. Full-section README review and actual function bodies prevented incorrect emulator-only and STUB-based rejection of SubterraCS. A large macro-file empty response was replaced by bounded SPC engine inspection. Empty repository 409 was distinguished from transient retrieval failure. No candidate code executed. Emulator-backed recompilation tooling is not promoted as a native game; assembly fallback and sparse semantics remain explicit.
